_doc: Meadow species planted from seed. plant_scale = game-scale size of every plant (the Poly Haven clumps are life-size, ~20-40 cm, too small to read from the game camera). stage_scale = model scale per stage (seed, sprout, young, mature, bloom). grow_s = seconds per stage while watered. water_s = how long one watering lasts. seed_yield = seeds dropped when it blooms. requires_research = research node that unlocks the species (locked species are never picked; new species go last so a locked roll falls back to the first species). biomes = only planted in those frontier districts (planet/frontiers.gd). cold_hardy = can grow outdoors in the Frozen Port once Cold-Hardy Seeds is researched (others need a greenhouse there). globe_heights = [v4grow] on the globe, the height in metres of a plant per stage (times its scale; 0 = only the sprout on its soil mound shows, plants/garden_marks.gd), no wider than globe_max_width.

auto_grow._doc: [v13goals] Owner 26 Nov: the player only cleans; clean ground greens by itself (plants/auto_grow.gd). player_planting false = no seeds, no watering, no planting tools, robots or goals; true brings the old planting game back. While false, every tick_s each clean land hex that HexLevels tracks may sprout one plant on a free soil slot (never on paving): chance tick_s / sow_s x rate, up to max_fill of its soil slots. rate = (1 + neighbour_boost x the share of its six neighbours that are clean) x growth x the plant_growth stat (research). Plants never get thirsty and grow one stage per grow_s / (garden growth x rate). The hex levels (data/hex_levels.json auto) follow from the plants: Grassy, Blooming, Lush, Thriving. Saved with the garden.
